html:
Remark. Archimedean-realisation framing of the topological mass formula

In the archimedean realisation (\mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe), the topological decomposition of mass (topological mass) specialises to a closed-form relationship between the mass of a particle, the hyperbolic volume of its associated knot, and the quantum Planck constant.
